prose: Geoffrey Huntley, quoted by Simon Willison, says that instead of updating AGENTS.md when an agent ignores his diagnostics library, he writes a pre-commit hook that fails the commit on direct calls to observability modules and injects a prompt telling the agent to use the library. After that, compliance goes to ten out of ten.
highlights: Instructions in AGENTS.md drift; a pre-commit hook enforces the rule.
Hook inspects the git diff for calls that bypass the diagnostics module.
Failed commit injects a corrective prompt, giving 10/10 compliance.
